intuition: The delay is the longest shortest-path distance from the source to any node.

brute_force.approach: Run a graph traversal from the source and enumerate possible paths to every node.
brute_force.time: Exponential in the number of vertices in the worst case

optimal.approach: Use Dijkstra's algorithm with a min-heap to finalize shortest distances for nonnegative edge weights.

edge_cases: A node unreachable from the source makes the answer -1.
A one-node network has delay zero.
